Label: util_Taxi_In_vehicle_time
Formula: skim.HOV2_TIME[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_TIME[d, o, in_period]

Label: util_Taxi_Fare
Formula: (Taxi_baseFare * 2 + (skim.HOV2_DIST[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_DIST[d, o, in_period]) * Taxi_costPerMile + (skim.HOV2_TIME[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_TIME[d, o, in_period]) * Taxi_costPerMinute) * 100

Label: util_TNC_Single_In_vehicle_time
Formula: skim.HOV2_TIME[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_TIME[d, o, in_period]

Label: util_TNC_Single_Cost
Formula: max(TNC_single_baseFare * 2 + (skim.HOV2_DIST[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_DIST[d, o, in_period]) * TNC_single_costPerMile + (skim.HOV2_TIME[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_TIME[d, o, in_period]) * TNC_single_costPerMinute, TNC_single_costMinimum) * 100

Label: util_TNC_Shared_In_vehicle_time
Formula: (skim.HOV2_TIME[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_TIME[d, o, in_period]) * TNC_shared_IVTFactor

Label: util_TNC_Shared_Cost
Formula: max(TNC_shared_baseFare * 2 + (skim.HOV2_DIST[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV2_DIST[d, o, in_period]) * TNC_shared_costPerMile + (skim.HOV2_TIME[o, d, out_period] + skim.HOV3_TIME[d, o, in_period]) * TNC_shared_costPerMinute, TNC_shared_costMinimum) * 100
